name: Grilled chicken
summary: Vietnam Tourism calls free-range grilled chicken Mang Den’s signature dish, seasoned in the mountain style. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal sells gà nướng cơm lam at the weekend market. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den. Vietnam Tourism names the chicken and does not name a street. Báo Kon Tum names gà nướng at a cultural night in town.
culture: Vietnam Tourism says food in Mang Den is fresh off a farm or a garden, and that this chicken has become the signature dish.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism describes free-range chicken fed on natural foods, grilled and seasoned in the traditional mountain style. A cut and a spice list were not printed.
The rural portal lists gà nướng cơm lam for sale at the weekend market. Báo Kon Tum serves gà nướng with cơm lam, thịt xiên, bánh nếp, and rượu cần after a race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.
A price is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Tourism does not name a street or a restaurant.
Báo Kon Tum places gà nướng at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”, after the race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.

Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
